candidate.name: CAC 40
candidate.priority_contract: Unchanged H01 comparator reservations, daily-breach consumption and post-defense closing guard.
candidate.description: BUY and SELL mirror each other. Require a breach at least one pre-breach ATR deep, reclaim within 24 H1 bars, bounded defense within eight bars and resumption within four. Preserve the original guarded defense and reservation logic.
candidate.limitation: Eight archived entries; none in October–November. Independent validation is pending.

management.BE: Two consecutive completed eligible H1 closes at least +1 ATR; guarded activation at the next eligible M1 opening.
management.costs: Recorded entry/exit spread proxy and adverse opening gaps; not a bid/ask tick-fill simulation.
management.censoring: A full 24-native-H1 horizon is required for a final score; a provisional target/stop touch remains unscored until then.
management.ATR_anchor: H01: pre-breach ATR. D04/F1W4: completed signal H1 ATR.
management.entry: First confirmed native M15 open at or after signal close; 15-minute publication can observe the entry later.
management.status: Research candidates. No broker orders. No independent 2024–2025 validation completed.

meta.clock: Native broker labels; historical EAT conversion unverified
